data.description: Live the marina lifestyle at Sur La Mer, Dubai.

data.answer: The Sur La Mer community in Dubai offers a family-friendly and tranquil setting with high-end facilities and leisure spaces. This masterfully planned neighborhood includes air-conditioned walkways, shaded seating areas, and ample green spaces, all surrounded by palm-lined streets and waterfront promenades. Residents benefit from exclusive access to swimming pools, gyms, and a children’s play area.

Sur La Mer properties in Dubai include 3, 4, and 5-bedroom beachfront townhouses. These duplex residences feature spacious layouts, elegant interiors, and modern amenities. A 3-bedroom townhouse typically spans around 3,700 sq. ft. Each unit has access to communal amenities and beach promenades. Sur La Mer is the only freehold townhouse complex in Jumeirah, which adds to its investment appeal.

Popular Buildings in Sur La Mer

As a townhouse-only community, Sur La Mer townhouses are the main residential structures. Each building is part of a harmoniously designed neighborhood offering sea views, lush landscapes, and proximity to key attractions.

Renting a Property in Sur La Mer

Rental trends for Sur La Mer properties in Dubai indicate premium pricing due to its luxury beachfront status:

  • 3-Bed: AED 599,000
  • 4-Bed: AED 639,000
  • 5-Bed: AED 1,349,000

Buying a Property in Sur La Mer

Buyers looking to invest in Sur La Mer, Dubai will find competitive yet lucrative pricing:

3-Bed: AED 11.12M
4-Bed: AED 15.96M
5-Bed: AED 27.88M

The highest ROI is seen in 3-bedroom townhouses (5.56%), followed by 5-bed (4.69%) and 4-bed (4.15%) units.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Sur La Mer, Dubai?

data.answer:
Life at Sur La Mer, Dubai is serene and upscale. Residents enjoy marina views, beachfront activities, and access to fine-dining establishments. It's a pedestrian-friendly environment with landscaped pathways, making it perfect for evening strolls and family outings.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Sur La Mer

Each townhouse includes dedicated parking for 2 to 3 cars. The area is well-connected by road and accessible via sea. Public bus stops like Palm Strip Center and Jumeirah Centre are just 3 minutes away, and World Trade Center Metro Station is a 13-minute drive.

Supermarkets Around Sur La Mer

Nearby grocery options include Silver Grand Supermarket, Sharq Al Madina Supermarket, and Tudomart Supermarket Jumeirah for everyday essentials. For budget-friendly shopping, residents can also visit Viva and West Zone Supermarkets, all reachable within a few minutes by car.

Shopping Mall Near Sur La Mer

Sur La Mer, Dubai is located just minutes away from popular retail destinations such as Jumaira Plaza, Jumeirah Centre, and Palm Strip Mall. These shopping venues offer a variety of high-end fashion, home decor, and dining options. Additionally, the La Mer beachfront itself is home to a range of premium retail outlets and designer boutiques, making shopping an integral part of the Sur La Mer community in Dubai.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near

Families residing in Sur La Mer, Dubai have access to several top-rated educational institutions. Nurseries near the Sur La Mer community in Dubai include Kinderville Nursery at Al Wasl 51, Green Grass Nursery, and Ladybird Nursery Jumeirah, catering to children from six months to four years of age. 

For older children, leading schools in the area are Jumeira Baccalaureate School, which follows the IB curriculum, Al Shaab School, and Al Shorouq Private School. These schools are located within a 6 to 7-minute drive, making them convenient options for residents of Sur La Mer townhouses.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Sur La Mer

The Sur La Mer community in Dubai is surrounded by various places of worship, catering to its multicultural residents. Jumeirah Mosque, located just 3 minutes away, is a renowned religious landmark in the city. Christian residents can visit Eleutheria Community Church, which is only a 6-minute drive. 

Additionally, the Sai Baba Temple and Mahamevnawa Buddhist Temple are both situated within a 7-minute drive, offering spiritual solace for the Hindu and Buddhist communities near Sur La Mer, Dubai.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Sur La Mer

Sur La Mer, Dubai is well-served by nearby medical facilities, ensuring quality healthcare for its residents. Prominent options include Infinity The Family Medicine Clinic and Jumeirah American Clinic, both located in The Village Mall, Jumeirah Beach Road. Another reliable choice is GMCClinics, situated on the first floor of Magrudy's Centre, Jumeirah Road. These clinics are all within a short driving distance from the Sur La Mer community in Dubai.

Location & Nearby Areas

Sur La Mer enjoys a prime location in Jumeirah 1, offering easy access to several prominent landmarks. The area is bordered by residential neighborhoods such as Al Badaa, Al Satwa, and Al Wasl, all within close driving distance.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Sur La Mer, Dubai

data.answer:
Residents of Sur La Mer, Dubai can enjoy a variety of entertainment options including water-filled fun at Laguna Waterpark, energetic play at Hawa Hawa inflatable playground, cinematic experiences at Roxy Cinema, and relaxing strolls along the scenic La Mer Walk.

Restaurants

Dining options around Sur La Mer, Dubai are abundant and diverse. Residents and visitors can enjoy a variety of cuisines at renowned restaurants such as Eunoia by Carine, Kai Enzo, Taverna Restaurant, Flooka Dubai, Society Dubai, and Turkish Village. La Mer itself also houses popular eateries including Zou Zou, Catch 22, and Sugar Factory, making it a culinary hotspot within the Sur La Mer community in Dubai.

Beaches Near Sur La Mer

La Mer Beach, located near Sur La Mer, Dubai, spans 1.24 million square meters and offers residents and visitors a vibrant seaside escape with cabanas, sunbeds, and a range of thrilling water sports activities.

Hotels Around Sur La Mer

There are several upscale hotels in Sur La Mer, Dubai. Hyatt Centric Jumeirah Dubai, located just a 2-minute drive away, offers stylish rooms with spectacular views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline.
Another nearby luxury option is Dubai Marine Beach Resort & Spa, a 5-star property just 7 minutes away, featuring premium suites, a private beach, multiple dining venues, and wellness facilities. These hotels enhance the overall lifestyle experience within the Sur La Mer community in Dubai.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

The Sur La Mer community in Dubai offers excellent options for outdoor activities, fitness, and self-care. Residents can unwind at nearby green spaces such as Etihad Museum Park and Wasl Community Park. 

For health and wellness, Cityman Power Gym & Fitness provides workout facilities, while Sisters Beauty Lounge and Sanctuary Spa deliver premium beauty and relaxation services, all within convenient reach of Sur La Mer, Dubai.

Community Events

Sur La Mer hosts year-round events, often promoted via the La Mer Dubai Facebook group.

Attractions and Landmarks

Residents are just a 3-minute drive from the iconic Jumeirah Mosque, 7 minutes from the historical Etihad Museum, and 9 minutes from Pearl Jumeirah. The famous Jumeirah Public Beach is also just 10 minutes away, providing ample opportunities for seaside relaxation and recreation. 

Other popular attractions near Sur La Mer, Dubai are Laguna Waterpark, the interactive and educational Etihad Museum, and Roxy Cinemas for an upscale movie experience.

Sur La Mer, Dubai offers an unmatched blend of luxury and coastal elegance, making it an ideal destination for those seeking an exclusive and vibrant lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most prestigious beachfront communities.

Where is Sur La Mer located?

Sur La Mer is in Port De La Mer, Jumeirah 1.

What type of properties are available?

3, 4, and 5-bedroom beachfront townhouses.

What amenities are available to residents?

Private beach access, clubhouse, gyms, pools, retail, dining, and marina access.

Is Sur La Mer pet-friendly?

Yes, Sur La Mer is a pet-friendly community, with ample outdoor spaces and walkways suitable for pet owners.

Can I access Sur La Mer by sea?

Yes, Sur La Mer offers marina access, allowing residents and visitors to arrive via yachts or boats.

data.content:
Developed by Meraas, Sur La Mer is located within Port De La Mer, offering exclusive access to the Arabian Gulf and a rich blend of dining, retail, and entertainment options. With scenic ocean views, tree-lined boulevards, and a vibrant seaside lifestyle, this premier destination is perfect for families, professionals, and investors alike.

Sur La Mer properties in Dubai consist of 147 elegant Italian-style townhouses ranging from 3 to 5 bedrooms. Each residence is designed to offer generous living spaces, private outdoor areas, and high-end finishes. It is the first freehold townhouse community in Jumeirah that stands out as a prime option for those seeking homeownership or high-return investment options.

Its strategic location near top landmarks, hotels, and beaches makes Sur La Mer townhouses highly desirable. The community offers resort-like living with amenities such as a clubhouse, private beach access, shaded walkways, retail outlets, and direct access to the marina. Residents also enjoy being minutes away from shopping malls, gourmet restaurants, international schools, and healthcare services.
